10378|bbe052dd.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|bbe052dd.text: Where can I send you today mage?

10668|19e45338.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|19e45338.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|36aec325.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|36aec325.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

11044|0556ba58.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|0556ba58.text:
Have you now? This certainly doesn't look like something I had asked for.

This potion is clearly inert, meaning it will no longer create reactions. Hence it is of no use to my studies.

Take it back to Alessandro. Perhaps next time he sends me a potion he can find someone with faster feet.

<Doctor Felben waves a dismissive hand.>

11044|98f6d0c2.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|98f6d0c2.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, Myrlin, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11049|8b5e44c8.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|8b5e44c8.text: Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!

11066|b615098a.name: Jhag
11066|b615098a.text: To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?

11067|e8016bc8.name: Malcomb Wynn
11067|e8016bc8.text: You don't look like much to me, but who knows, maybe there's an enchanter hidden in there somewhere!

11833|65ba1433.name: Rahauro
11833|65ba1433.text:
Well met, mage. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

12136|866b6683.name: Snurk Bucksquick
12136|866b6683.text: Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat.

14726|65d66388.name: Rashona Straglash
14726|65d66388.text:
In these trying times, a simple donation of cloth can go a long way to help those less fortunate than ourselves.  Cloth goes a long way to making garments and bandages - both important for the war effort!

If you are interested in donating cloth pieces to the orcs of Orgrimmar, I will gladly accept them and make sure you receive the proper recognition for doing so.

For the Horde!

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth.  Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague.  We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1950|aa9cd6e2.name: Rane Yorick
1950|aa9cd6e2.text: My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.

1952|01aed514.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|01aed514.text: Hello, Mage.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2055|288436fb.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055|288436fb.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2425|4aecbd96.name: Varimathras
2425|4aecbd96.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, mage. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

248199|4ee395b7.name: Beneris
248199|4ee395b7.text: Oh! Greetings, friend. Feel free to browse my wares.

2492|aa6f2374.name: Lexington Mortaim
2492|aa6f2374.text: As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

249363|260391fc.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|260391fc.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes now remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251373|86bf8d52.name: Xyton Silverwind
251373|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

251376|fb6560cd.name: Tai'ree Farsight
251376|fb6560cd.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

251389|87ef59fc.name: Akeri Duskblade
251389|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

251487|e92a645e.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|e92a645e.text: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

256388|6578af6f.name: Jornah
256388|6578af6f.text:
I am glad you asked! We are far more than just a delivery service, Myrlin. We employ and contract craftsman across a variety of specialties and trades, and keep our ear to the ground for any new opportunities to keep their hands busy and goods flowing. We cannot possibly predict the emergent needs of any potential client, so we depend on their crafting orders to arrive to us.

You can imagine that this pipeline is... not as effective as we would hope. We encourage any crafters to satisfy these demands and deliver the goods directly to the customers,  wherever they may be. Worry not, you will be fairly compensated for your troubles and earn respect among our organization.

256388|70cda348.name: Jornah
256388|70cda348.text:
Greetings and well met, Myrlin! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

267009|ed3f7394.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|ed3f7394.text: Be careful, mage. There are cultists nearby.

271613|0980e046.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|0980e046.text: <The body looks incomplete and awaiting a head.>

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3004|dfa12b04.name: Tepa
3004|dfa12b04.text: You are truly a determined student. I will be happy to provide you with instruction!

3084|a56de79f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a56de79f.text: First Aid is always a nice skill to have.  Many a time during battle has it saved my hide.  Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise.  Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.

3216|4cb32313.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|4cb32313.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, mage.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3345|335c06e7.name: Godan
3345|335c06e7.text: You may have what it takes. Let's find out!

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3429|01a1e491.name: Thork
3429|01a1e491.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, mage. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|3d594cb5.name: Mankrik
3432|3d594cb5.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, mage, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3446|fa56d5e5.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|fa56d5e5.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the orc I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|c2224a6c.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|c2224a6c.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, mage.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4568|4670f054.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|4670f054.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

4576|4eaf08fa.name: Josef Gregorian
4576|4eaf08fa.text: I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!

4616|9948e984.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|9948e984.text: No, no, you'll need FAR more training before you're ready to learn from me! Go talk to that uptight dabbler Malcomb Wynn. He's the one buried in books over there.

4616|ac0ef905.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|ac0ef905.text: Hmm, you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. If you do what I ask, and do it well, maybe we can discuss your training.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

5624|4b4eb4b7.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|4b4eb4b7.text: You go to inner ring of The Apothecarium.  Lavinia Crowe is there.

5624|f669426b.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f669426b.text: Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5769|c626a1cf.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c626a1cf.text: The earth keeps many secrets, mage; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5885|a7455611.name: Deino
5885|a7455611.text: Greetings, mage.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7683|21424dde.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|21424dde.text: Yes, I see that. I can't say I'm pleased yet another one of my brilliant concoctions has been wasted.

7683|70f4a6e4.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|70f4a6e4.text:
<Alessandro lets out a frustrated sigh and pinches the bridge of his nose with boney fingers.>

Fine. Yes, give it here. At least I can reuse the glass vial.

7683|dc498649.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|dc498649.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, mage.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1013-accept.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-accept.text:
Myrlin, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection.  Ur was a great mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the Forsaken.

Enter Shadowfang Keep and find the book.  Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
1013-accept.title: The Book of Ur

1014-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-accept.text:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, Myrlin. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
1014-accept.title: Arugal Must Die

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1098-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-accept.text:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, Myrlin.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, Myrlin.  Do not fail.
1098-accept.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1358-accept.name: Apothecary Zinge
1358-accept.text:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
1358-accept.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-complete.text:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, Myrlin.  Your reward is well earned.
1358-complete.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-progress.text: You have a package for me?
1358-progress.title: Sample for Helbrim

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

1359-complete.name: Apothecary Zinge
1359-complete.text: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
1359-complete.title: Zinge's Delivery

1486-accept.name: Nalpak
1486-accept.text:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
1486-accept.title: Deviate Hides

1487-accept.name: Ebru
1487-accept.text:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, Myrlin, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
1487-accept.title: Deviate Eradication

1489-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
1489-accept.text:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
1489-accept.title: Hamuul Runetotem

1489-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
1489-complete.text: I bid you greetings, Myrlin.  You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength.  For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.
1489-complete.title: Hamuul Runetotem

1490-accept.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
1490-accept.text:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.
1490-accept.title: Nara Wildmane

1490-complete.name: Nara Wildmane
1490-complete.text:
Yes, it is true.  I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns.  I have seen their twisted, scaled faces.  I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

You must stop them, Myrlin.
1490-complete.title: Nara Wildmane

1491-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-accept.text:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
1491-accept.title: Smart Drinks

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

1960-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-accept.text:
Algernon's alchemist shop in the Apothecarium is the locus of a strange disturbance.  Invisible creatures, made solely of magic, wander the shop--there must be a reason, and we must find it!

Investigate the disturbance and capture those creatures.  Take a chest of coffers and a scroll from behind me.  Use the scroll at the shop to make the creatures visible, subdue them with your spells, then throw down a coffer to capture them.  Return with the filled coffers, the empty coffers and the cantation.
1960-accept.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1960-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-complete.text:
Very good, Myrlin.  The creatures within these containment coffers will be studied by our finest minds, and the reason behind their presence in the Undercity will be determined.

If their appearance is caused by a rift in the natural flow of magic, then we must determine if the rift was random.  If it was not random, but instead an attack by some magical force, then we must prepare for future, more serious disturbances.
1960-complete.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1960-progress.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1960-progress.text: Have you investigated the disturbance, Myrlin?  Have you captured the creatures?
1960-progress.title: Investigate the Alchemist Shop

1961-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1961-accept.text:
It is time for you to don your first mage's robes, Myrlin.  They are a sign of your station, and a testament to your worth.

To gain the robes, you must gather the mana gems from the Dalaran mages of Silverpine.  Their beliefs are similar to ours and so killing them is somewhat distasteful, but if they lack the strength to resist us, then they do not deserve their lives.

Bring the gems and a supply of linen to Josef Gregorian at the Magic Quarter's tailor shop.
1961-accept.title: Gathering Materials

1961-complete.name: Josef Gregorian
1961-complete.text: This is very good material, and although I lack the talent to gauge the quality of these mana gems, we'll soon know if they possess the power needed to create spellfire robes...
1961-complete.title: Gathering Materials

1961-progress.name: Josef Gregorian
1961-progress.text: Anastasia said you would come to me, and I am prepared to fashion your robes.  Do you have the gems and the linen?
1961-progress.title: Gathering Materials

1962-complete.name: Josef Gregorian
1962-complete.text: Here are your robes, Myrlin.  Wear them well.
1962-complete.title: Spellfire Robes

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, Myrlin! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

264-complete.name: Clarice Foster
264-complete.text:
You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.

As you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. For a moment everything around you is silent.
264-complete.title: Until Death Do Us Part

264-progress.name: Clarice Foster
264-progress.text:
The stone is cold to the touch,  but has obviously been abused. Trash litters the area; nicks and gashes decorate the relief atop the coffin; and the foliage around the grave has started to grow over the site.

No one cares for whoever is buried here, especially not any victims of the plague.
264-progress.title: Until Death Do Us Part

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, Myrlin.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

3301-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
3301-accept.text:
My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies.  Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life.  Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

Take a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
3301-accept.title: Mura Runetotem

3301-complete.name: Mura Runetotem
3301-complete.text:
Ah, what is this?  This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life.  Amazing!  I must study it further.

Thank you, Myrlin.  With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.
3301-complete.title: Mura Runetotem

3301-progress.name: Mura Runetotem
3301-progress.text: I can smell the dust of the Barrens on you, mage.  You have traveled far.
3301-progress.title: Mura Runetotem

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, mage.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

422-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-complete.text: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, mage.  If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
422-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

422-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-progress.text: Before I know what we are dealing with here, mage, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
422-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

423-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-accept.text:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
423-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

435-accept.name: Deathstalker Erland
435-accept.text:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
435-accept.title: Escorting Erland

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, Myrlin.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

437-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-complete.text:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, Myrlin, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.
437-complete.title: The Dead Fields

437-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-progress.text: Have you defeated Nightlash, Myrlin?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
437-progress.title: The Dead Fields

438-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-accept.text:
Myrlin, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
438-accept.title: The Decrepit Ferry

438-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Corpse Laden Boat
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: Myrlin.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

440-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-complete.text:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago.  She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed.  I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
440-complete.title: The Engraved Ring

440-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-progress.text: Hello, Myrlin.  What brings you back to Brill?
440-progress.title: The Engraved Ring

441-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
441-accept.text:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
441-accept.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

441-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
441-complete.text:
Yes, this ring was my wife's.  Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times.  I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me.  But desire does still burn in my dead heart, Myrlin.

Desire for revenge.
441-complete.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, mage.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, Myrlin.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

477-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-complete.text:
<Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict Silverpine Forest and other parts of western Lordaeron.

Underneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>
477-complete.title: Border Crossings

478-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-accept.text: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
478-accept.title: Maps and Runes

478-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-complete.text:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
478-complete.title: Maps and Runes

478-progress.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-progress.text: Have you learned anything useful, Myrlin?
478-progress.title: Maps and Runes

479-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-accept.text:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
479-accept.title: Ambermill Investigations

479-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-complete.text:
Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.

A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.
479-complete.title: Ambermill Investigations

479-progress.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-progress.text: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.
479-progress.title: Ambermill Investigations

481-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
481-accept.text: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
481-accept.title: Dalar's Analysis

481-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
481-complete.text:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
481-complete.title: Dalar's Analysis

482-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
482-accept.text:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
482-accept.title: Dalaran's Intentions

482-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
482-complete.text:
Ill news you bring, Myrlin. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
482-complete.title: Dalaran's Intentions

4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, mage, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle

5041-accept.name: Thork
5041-accept.text:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
5041-accept.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

516-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
516-accept.text:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
516-accept.title: Beren's Peril

530-accept.name: Raleigh Andrean
530-accept.text:
Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer.  Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge.  If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
530-accept.title: A Husband's Revenge

5722-accept.name: Rahauro
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rahauro
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5723-complete.name: Rahauro
5723-complete.text:
I am glad to see you took Magatha's task seriously. Thank you, Myrlin. I'm sure the troggs will have a harder time coming to the surface with their numbers so greatly reduced.

Perhaps in the future we can take time to figure out where such creatures came from, and what they really want.
5723-complete.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5724-complete.name: Rahauro
5724-complete.text:
Excellent, Myrlin. Thank you.

Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
5724-complete.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5724-progress.name: Rahauro
5724-progress.text: Were you able to find anything, Myrlin? Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.
5724-progress.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5725-accept.name: Varimathras
5725-accept.text:
Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

A sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
5725-accept.title: The Power to Destroy...

5725-complete.name: Varimathras
5725-complete.text: Good, mage. You have done well in serving the Dark Lady. Your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects. Return to me again in the future. Perhaps I will have other tasks for you that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge.
5725-complete.title: The Power to Destroy...

5725-progress.name: Varimathras
5725-progress.text: There are a hundred other tasks awaiting my attention, mage. Do you have the books?
5725-progress.title: The Power to Destroy...

5728-complete.name: Thrall
5728-complete.text: I am glad you've returned, Myrlin. Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below Orgrimmar were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. It seems we've put a dent in his armor. I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.
5728-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5729-accept.name: Thrall
5729-accept.text:
I think our next step should be to have you placed close to Neeru. If he is as agitated as reports suggest, then we may accomplish two things. One, you may be able to gain some greater knowledge about the Council or at least the Burning Blade, and two, he may just begin to trust you enough that he asks you to start to aid him. He may very well look at you as someone who can fill the void now that some of the leadership is in turmoil.

Return to the Cleft and speak to him again, but do not be too overt.
5729-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5729-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
5729-complete.text: What is it?! Oh, you, mage... my apologies. My anger rivals that of a rabid kodo bull... but perhaps it is my own fault. In sending travelers into Ragefire Chasm, I should have seen the possibility that some harm would come from it. It seems both Bazzalan and Jergosh were taken unaware and slain by some of Thrall's do-gooders. A most inopportune time, but there is nothing that can be done about it now.
5729-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5730-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5730-accept.text:
You are one of my lieutenants! Prepare yourself, mage. I will call upon you soon.

My time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the Shadow Council's schemes elsewhere must suffer. I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the Barrens and Ashenvale begin work on our newest agenda. Return to me soon.
5730-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5730-complete.name: Thrall
5730-complete.text:
Ashenvale? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in Ashenvale. My spies will investigate, Myrlin. You have done well.

For now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.

Lok-Tar Ogar!
5730-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-complete.text:
Ha! You've done it! Thrall will be so pleased.

I will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.

For now though, you must celebrate your victory. I will inform Thrall of your success.

Thank you for your aid, mage.
5761-complete.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-progress.text: Have you killed the beast? He surely must be the leader of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm.
5761-progress.title: Slaying the Beast

6386-complete.name: Zargh
6386-complete.text:
Hah!  I guess she liked it!  Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!

Thank you, Myrlin.  You've done me a great service.  Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
6386-complete.title: Return to the Crossroads

6386-progress.name: Zargh
6386-progress.text: Have you returned from Orgrimmar?  Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?
6386-progress.title: Return to the Crossroads

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

865-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
865-complete.title: Raptor Horns

865-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-progress.text: Did you get the horns, Myrlin?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!
865-progress.title: Raptor Horns

869-complete.name: Gazrog
869-complete.text:
You got rid of the raptors!

Thank you, Myrlin.  You are a mage of worth.
869-complete.title: Raptor Thieves

869-progress.name: Gazrog
869-progress.text: Do you have those heads, Myrlin?
869-progress.title: Raptor Thieves

870-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-complete.text:
You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it?  Strange.  This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

But it is a clue.  And I am grateful that you found it.
870-complete.title: The Forgotten Pools

871-accept.name: Thork
871-accept.text:
All the quilboars are our enemies, Myrlin. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
871-accept.title: Disrupt the Attacks

877-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-accept.text:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
877-accept.title: The Stagnant Oasis

877-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-complete.text:
Your findings are amazing!  The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead.  Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!

We must study this more...
877-complete.title: The Stagnant Oasis

880-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-accept.text:
Your findings are incredible, Myrlin.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
880-accept.title: Altered Beings

880-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-complete.text:
Thank you, Myrlin.  Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself.  We shall see what tale these shells tell.

Please accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins.  I find that I do not need them.
880-complete.title: Altered Beings

880-progress.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-progress.text: How goes your collection?  Did you get the shells?
880-progress.title: Altered Beings

914-accept.name: Nara Wildmane
914-accept.text:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, Myrlin.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
914-accept.title: Leaders of the Fang

92401-accept.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-accept.text:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401-accept.title: A Frightened Request

92401-complete.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-complete.text:
What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.

I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.
92401-complete.title: A Frightened Request

92421-accept.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-accept.text:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421-accept.title: Light's Justice

92421-complete.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-complete.text:
Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!

With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
92421-complete.title: Light's Justice

92421-progress.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-progress.text: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?
92421-progress.title: Light's Justice

92422-accept.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-accept.text:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, Myrlin.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422-accept.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92422-complete.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-complete.text:
While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.

Thank you Myrlin.
92422-complete.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, rogue. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, Agravain. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92598-complete.name: Ventaari Brightwish
92598-complete.text:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.
92598-complete.title: The Gift of Skysight

95216-accept.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-accept.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216-accept.title: The New Plague

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95216-progress.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-progress.text:
Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.

I must see this strain for myself!
95216-progress.title: The New Plague

95774-accept.name: Mankrik
95774-accept.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774-accept.title: Her Name Is Olgra

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

95981-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981-accept.title: Watching the Roads

962-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, Myrlin. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom

96895-accept.name: Deathguard Terrence
96895-accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895-accept.title: The Argent Emissary

96895-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96895-complete.text: Stay low and try not to be seen, mage. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
96895-complete.title: The Argent Emissary

96897-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-accept.text: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897-accept.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
96898-accept.title: Remnants of War

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

97288-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97288-complete.text:
Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.

I think I have a use for this.
97288-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97289-complete.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-complete.text:
<The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>

You...
97289-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-progress.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-progress.text: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289-progress.title: Unending Torment

97290-accept.name: Unfinished Abomination
97290-accept.text:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290-accept.title: Unending Torment

97290-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97290-complete.text: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
97290-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-accept.text:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291-accept.title: Unending Torment

97291-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-complete.text: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
97291-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-progress.text: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291-progress.title: Unending Torment

97292-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-accept.text:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292-accept.title: Unending Torment

97292-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-complete.text:
Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.

I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
97292-complete.title: Unending Torment

97292-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-progress.text:
For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.

And it's funny...
97292-progress.title: Unending Torment

97558-accept.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, Myrlin. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558-accept.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97891-accept.name: Alessandro Luca
97891-accept.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891-accept.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97891-complete.name: Doctor Martin Felben
97891-complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
97891-complete.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97903-complete.name: Rawrk
97903-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97903-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

99052-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-complete.text:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!

Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052-complete.title: Threat from Below
